description: The PV array as one electrical source. Nothing measures the array directly: every telemetry value here is either copied from the MPPT or estimated by the physics model (Lesson 5).

contents.name: tiltDeg
contents.description: Angle between the module plane and horizontal: 0 = flat, 90 = vertical.

contents.name: azimuthDeg
contents.description: Direction the module faces, as a compass bearing clockwise from north: 180 = due south.

contents.name: panelVoltageV
contents.description: Not in Victron Instant Readout; absent in live mode until a source exists.

contents.name: panelCurrentA
contents.description: Not in Victron Instant Readout; absent in live mode until a source exists.

contents.name: powerW
contents.description: Same physical quantity as MpptChargeController.pvPowerW, seen from the array's side.

contents.name: irradianceWm2
contents.description: Derived, not measured: back-calculated from power and module temperature by the PV model.

contents.name: moduleTempC
contents.description: Estimated from ambient temperature and irradiance until a sensor exists.

contents.name: feeds
contents.description: Electrical topology: the array is wired to this charge controller's PV input.
